summary_markdown:
The conversation addressed the structural placement of advertising networks in Finland. Initially, it was noted that JCdecax Finland should not be placed under JCD because the primary negotiation partner is Mediateko Finland (a company involved in a tender). Since one company cannot be listed under two partners, concerns were raised about potential account violations due to previous transfers.

[me] confirmed that the structure needed correction and proceeded with adjustments. The final agreed-upon structure was: "Media Audit Finland Oy" as the main entity, with both "Mediateko" and "JCdecax Finland" placed under it. [me] noted that placing JCdecax Finland directly under Mediateko would yield unpredictable results.
decisions: The primary account structure for Finnish advertising networks will use Media Audit Finland Oy as the parent entity.
Both Mediateko and JCdecax Finland will be placed under Media Audit Finland Oy.
